s0DA71B.name: Object: big bush
summary: Draws a 9x5 bush into the Map16 map from table DATA_0DA6EE (blank $25 is skipped).
Uses the bush tile adder at $0DA78D so tiles blend with an existing bush.

s0DA748.name: Map16 tiles: small bush
summary: 6 tiles per row, 4 rows. $25 = blank (not drawn).

s0DA760.name: Object: small bush and bush tile adder
summary: Draws a 6x4 bush from DATA_0DA748. Tile adder at $0DA78D: blank $25 is skipped; tiles >= $54 are bumped by 1 or 2 when drawn over an existing bush tile.
Parameters: Y: [$57] map position.

s0DA7B1.name: Map16 tiles: net door
summary: 4 columns x 4 rows.

s0DA7C1.name: Object: net door
summary: Draws the 4x4 climbing net door from DATA_0DA7B1.

s0DA7E7.name: Object: goal sign
summary: Draws the 2x2 goal sign from DATA_0DA7E3 (page 0).

s0DA809.name: Map16 tiles: steep slopes (vertical level)
summary: Top tiles $AA/$AF, bottom tiles $E2/$E4 for objects $91/$92.

s0DA80D.name: Object: steep slope, vertical-level safe
summary: Two tiles high (page 1). Object number $91/$92 selects left/right.
Also contains CODE_0DA82A: move position down one row, updating the pointer high byte by 2 on carry.

s0DA83E.name: Map16 tiles: normal slopes (vertical level)
summary: Top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right tiles for objects $93/$94.

s0DA846.name: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe
summary: 2x2 slope (page 1). Object number $93/$94 selects left/right.

s0DA877.name: Map16 tiles: very steep slopes
summary: Top $CA/$CC, middle $CB/$CD, bottom $F1/$F2 for objects $95/$96.

s0DA87D.name: Object: very steep slope, vertical-level safe
summary: One column, three rows (page 1). Object number $95/$96 selects left/right.

s0DA8A6.name: Data: bit masks and rectangle object tables
summary: Bit masks $80-$01; item memory table offsets for coins (low/high bytes); Map16 tile per rectangle object ID (X).

s0DA8C3.name: Rectangle objects and Map16 pointer helpers
summary: Fills a width x height rectangle with the Map16 tile for the object ID in X. Size in [$59]: low nibble width - 1, high nibble height - 1.
Coins (X = 4) first check item memory ($19F8+) and are skipped if already collected.
Followed by helpers: $0DA95B add tile and move right, $0DA97D move down, $0DA992 down-left, $0DA9B4 down-right, $0DA9D6/$0DA9EF previous/next screen.
Parameters: Y: [$57] position; X: object ID index.

Sta1To6ePointer.name: Set Map16 high byte at pointer
summary: Sta1To6ePointer: store 1 to [$6E],Y (tile page $1xx). $0DAA0F: store [A] to [$6E],Y (page 0 when entered via StzTo6ePointer0080E7).

s0DAA12.name: Map16 tiles: vertical pipes
summary: By type 0-4: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right (0 = unused).

s0DAA26.name: Object: vertical pipe
summary: Height in high nibble of [$59], type in low nibble. Types 0-2 have a top cap, types 2-4 a bottom cap, 5 = endless pipe.
Body tiles $135/$136; endless uses $168/$169.

s0DAAA4.name: Map16 tiles: horizontal pipes
summary: End tiles then middle tiles, top/bottom pair per type.

s0DAAB4.name: Objects: horizontal pipe, bullet shooter, slope dispatch
summary: Horizontal pipe: size in low nibble, type in high nibble (types 2-3 end on the right).
Bullet shooter: height in high nibble, tiles $141/$142/$143.
Slope: type = [$59] AND $0F dispatched through PtrsLong0DAB50.

PtrsLong0DAB50.name: Pointer table: slope types; normal left slope
summary: 10 long pointers by slope type. Followed by the normal left slope routine, which draws the surface tiles $196/$19B, body $1DE/$1E6 and fill $03F row by row.

s0DABF7.name: Data: slope tile adjustment tables
summary: Tiles $3F, $01, $03 and the amounts added to them for the slope surface tile helper.
